title: [a11y] Hamburger can be focused and operated with the keyboard
actual_result: At 375x812 the hamburger is a <span class="menu-burger"> with no tabindex, role or aria-label. Tab order went skip-link -> logo -> body content links; the hamburger never received focus (also not within 40 Tab presses on retry), so Enter/Space could not be tested on it.
expected_result: The hamburger is reachable with Tab, shows a visible focus indicator, and opens/closes the menu with Enter and Space (currently it is a <span> without tabindex or role).
error_message: Hamburger not keyboard focusable: document.activeElement never equals .menu-burger

attempts.note: Tab sequence: skip-link, logo, then in-content links (History, HPD pdf, Resources...); hamburger skipped.
After reload, 40 Tab presses: hamburger never focused; menu stayed closed.

title: CTA Contact button opens the Contact page
actual_result: Clicking the CTA band "Contact" button (a.box-link, href /contact) navigated to https://dev.skyline.glass/contact/ (HTTP 200, title "Contact - Skyline", h1 "Contact Us").
expected_result: The Contact page loads (HTTP 200, no error page). Either /contact or /contact/ is accepted as the final URL.

title: All social links use HTTPS
actual_result: Footer social hrefs: Instagram https://, LinkedIn https://, Facebook https://, YouTube http://www.youtube.com/@skyline-glass (not HTTPS). Same result on both attempts.
expected_result: All four hrefs start with https://. An http:// link is a defect (the browser blocks it as Mixed Content).

attempts.note: After reload, same http:// YouTube href

title: Five portraits are displayed and load
actual_result: Design Leadership carousel shows exactly 5 portraits (Girard, Urquiola, Bouroullec, Scholten & Baijings, Tick); all render visibly and each image URL loads (naturalWidth 300-398). Note: portraits are CSS background-images on .image-holder divs, not elements, so the naturalWidth check was done by loading each background URL.
expected_result: Exactly 5 portraits are present and each renders as an image (no broken-image icon).

title: Header shows logo, all 7 nav links in order and search icon
actual_result: Header shows the Skyline logo, nav links in order Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote, Get a Sample (all on one row, same y=32 and height 51), and a search icon (span.header__search). No label truncated or wrapped.
expected_result: Header shows the Skyline logo, the links Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote, Get a Sample in this order, and a search icon. No label is missing, truncated or wrapped onto a second line.

title: Nav link hrefs point to the correct pages
actual_result: Hrefs on dev host: Products=/products/, Portfolio=/projects/, Resources=/resources/, About=/about/, Contact=/contact/, Get a Quote=/quote-request/, Get a Sample=/sample-request/ - all match Test Data.
expected_result: Each href resolves to the path listed in Test Data (same dev host). Note: the label is "Portfolio" while the URL is /projects/.

title: Logo links to the home page
actual_result: Clicking the header logo navigated to https://dev.skyline.glass/ (HTTP 200, title "Decorative Glass, Whiteboards, and Smart Glass Products"); home page rendered without error.
expected_result: Browser navigates to the home page (/) on the dev host; the home page renders without an error.

title: Contact link opens the Contact page
actual_result: Clicking "Contact" in the header navigated to https://dev.skyline.glass/contact/ (HTTP 200, title "Contact - Skyline", h1 "Contact Us").
expected_result: URL becomes /contact/ and the Contact page loads (HTTP 200, no error page).

title: Get a Quote link opens the quote request page
actual_result: Clicking "Get a Quote" navigated to https://dev.skyline.glass/quote-request/ (HTTP 200, title "Request a Quote - Skyline", h1 "Request a Quote").
expected_result: URL becomes /quote-request/ and the quote request page loads (HTTP 200, no error page).

title: Get a Sample link opens the sample request page
actual_result: Clicking "Get a Sample" navigated to https://dev.skyline.glass/sample-request/ (HTTP 200, title "Request a Sample - Skyline", h1 "Request a Sample").
expected_result: URL becomes /sample-request/ and the sample request page loads (HTTP 200, no error page).

title: Hamburger is shown and desktop nav is hidden on mobile
actual_result: At 375x812 the header shows the SKYLINE logo, a search icon and the hamburger (#menu-burger-opener, 50x50, visible). The only visible link in the header area is the logo; no desktop nav links are displayed.
expected_result: The header shows the logo, a search icon and a hamburger icon. The desktop nav links are not displayed.

title: Hamburger opens the menu with all expected items
actual_result: Tapping the hamburger opened a full-screen menu listing Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote and Get a Sample.
expected_result: The menu opens and lists Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote and Get a Sample.

title: Menu item navigates to the correct page
actual_result: After opening the menu and tapping Contact, the URL became https://dev.skyline.glass/contact/ and the page loaded with HTTP 200, title 'Contact - Skyline', H1 'Contact Us'. (A first click attempt on a duplicate hidden menu node timed out; clicking the visible menu link worked, no retry of the page flow was needed.)
expected_result: URL becomes /contact/ and the Contact page loads (HTTP 200, no error page).

title: Menu can be closed and the page returns to normal
actual_result: Tapping the hamburger opened the menu; tapping #menu-burger-opener again closed it (menu nav became visibility:hidden/opacity:0). The /about/ hero and header were fully visible again and the page scrolled normally (scrollY reached 600 and 1200; html uses smooth scroll-behavior).
expected_result: The menu closes, the page content slides back, and the /about/ page is fully visible and scrollable.

title: Page title is "About Skyline Design"
actual_result: document.title is exactly "About Skyline Design" at 1536x864.
expected_result: Document title is exactly "About Skyline Design".

title: Hero heading text is visible on load
actual_result: After ~3s the hero text "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass." is visible (effective opacity 1, visibility visible, 904x52 at y=387), centred over the hero image and not clipped or overlapped by the 84px header.
expected_result: The hero text "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass." is visible, fully opaque and not clipped or overlapped by the header.

actual_result: Exactly one <h1> exists but it is empty (innerHTML is a single space); the hero text "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass." is rendered in a <div class="font-bold type-42 ..."> instead. Reproduced on both attempts.
expected_result: Exactly one <h1> exists and its text is "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass." (currently the h1 is empty and the hero text is in a <div> — confirmed defect).
error_message: Assertion mismatch: h1 text is "" (expected "Over 40 years of Chicago-made glass.")

still empty.

title: Meta description is present and not empty
actual_result: One meta[name="description"] exists with content "Skyline Design is your source for sustainable architectural glass products: whiteboards, partitions, railings, doors, smart glass and more. Contact us today." — a non-empty, human-readable sentence, not a placeholder.
expected_result: A meta description tag exists and its content is a non-empty, human-readable sentence (not a placeholder such as "Just another WordPress site").

title: No horizontal overflow on desktop (1536px)
actual_result: After loading /about/ at 1536x864 and scrolling top to bottom (page height 6835px), document.documentElement.scrollWidth was 1526 (max over the whole scroll), not exceeding the 1536px viewport. No horizontal scrollbar; only the off-screen reCAPTCHA badge extends past the viewport and does not affect scrollWidth.
expected_result: scrollWidth does not exceed the viewport width; there is no horizontal scrollbar and no section is cut off.

actual_result: After loading /about/ at 768x1024 and scrolling top to bottom (page height 8350px), document.documentElement.scrollWidth was 758 (max over the whole scroll), not exceeding the 768px viewport. No horizontal scrollbar; only the collapsed off-canvas mobile menu and the reCAPTCHA badge extend past the viewport and do not affect scrollWidth.
expected_result: scrollWidth does not exceed the viewport width; there is no horizontal scrollbar and no section is cut off.
